name: Tetris Battle
subtitle: Everyone plays Tetris on their phone. Last stack standing wins.
description: Each phone runs its own lag-free game of Tetris with big touch buttons, while the TV shows everyone's board live. Clear 2 or more lines at once to send junk rows to a random opponent (a Tetris sends 4). Top out and you're out. The last player standing wins. Play alone for a high score.
